'''''Star Wars: Obi-Wan and Anakin''''', stylized as '''''Obi-Wan & Anakin''''', is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Charles Soule]] and illustrated by [[Marco Checchetto]]. The five-issue series is set three [[Standard year|years]] after [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and focuses on [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker]] as they explore the [[planet]] of [[Carnelion IV]] to answer a mysterious distress call. The series also features flashbacks, scattered across every issue, that detail the beginning of Anakin's trust towards [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].
